summary: No major rules contradiction found. One small operational omission remains: normal discard instructions select a card from hand unless otherwise specified.
scope: Original English 2023 Dune: Imperium – Uprising v23-10-12; standard 2–4-player game with the required scoring two-player Rival, optional standard 20-contract CHOAM module, and applicable general/Uprising official FAQ clarifications dated 2025-01-13. Excludes solo-only rules, optional Rival variants, six-player teams, and expansion combinations. The ten Rise of Ix contracts were checked only for identification/exclusion.

findings.title: State that ordinary discards come from the hand

summary_reference.text: Whenever you’re directed to discard a card, it cannot be an Intrigue card unless specified.

findings.finding: The Discarding rule correctly excludes Intrigue cards by default, but never states the default source zone. Unlike trashing (which the summary allows from hand, discard pile, or in play), a normal instruction to discard means choosing a card from your hand unless otherwise specified. The later Spacing Guild’s Favor clarification is card-specific and does not state this general rule.
findings.impact: A reader could treat a normal discard cost/effect as payable with a card already in play or in the discard pile, avoiding the required loss from hand. This is a narrow omission, not a structural rules error.
findings.recommended_correction: Add: “Unless otherwise specified, discard a card of your choice from your hand.” Keep the existing Intrigue exclusion.
